cohort: 81 patients who underwent EPH out of 161,836 births at a tertiary center in Istanbul, Turkey
finding: The rate of EPH increased significantly from 2000 to 2013, primarily due to the rising rate of cesarean sections.
mod_finding: This study found that the rate of emergency peripartum hysterectomy increased from 2000 to 2013, mostly related to the increasing rate of cesarean section.
